scope: Typed CV reference returns from an already active finalizer; actual consumed outer reference-return cursor only.

cases.source:
<?php
$x="old";$y="new";$n=0;
function ping(){echo "P;";}
function &f():string{global $x,$y,$n;try{return $x;}finally{echo "O;";ping();try{return $y;}finally{++$n;echo "I",$n,";";if($n===1){$y=new stdClass;}else{$y="fixed";}}}}
try{$r=&f();echo "BAD:",$r,";";}catch(TypeError $e){echo "R;";}
echo "x=",$x,";n=",$n,";yfixed=",(int)($y==="fixed"),";";
